basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bathinda Counsellor (Psychiatry) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Addiction Treatment Facility (ATF) at All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bathinda, set up under the National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction (NAPDDR) and supported by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, is engaging a Counsellor on a purely contractual basis for 2 vacancies (UR-02) at consolidated remuneration of Rs 56,100/- per month. Eligible Indian Nationals with M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology, aged between 21-35 years, must fill the Google Form from 20 November 2026 to 19 December 2026, 05:00 PM IST, and then attend a walk-in interview

application_fee.details: The fee is non-refundable and is paid through the online payment gateway only, at https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm?corpID=2322756. The transaction reference number and date of transaction must be written in the application form. OBC/SC/ST candidates may apply but get no concession or relaxation. Applications without the prescribed fee are summarily rejected.

how_to_apply: Fill the Google Form at https://forms.gle/eEztGsBtsGFy8fKF7 and submit it by 19 December 2026, 05:00 PM IST. Without this, the application is not considered complete.
Pay the application fee online through the payment link given above.
Download the application form provided on the AIIMS Bathinda website and fill it in, mentioning the fee transaction reference number and date.

Bring the duly filled application form, the hard copy of the form as uploaded with the Google Form, proof of fee deposited (transaction receipt) and one set of self-attested photocopies on the interview day.
Bring brief bio-data in the proforma attached to the notice, with certificates of age, qualification, experience and caste.
Appear in person with all original certificates at Ground Floor, Admin Block, Medical College Building, AIIMS Bathinda. The notice says no hard copy needs to be sent.
Qualification proof (as mentioned in the essential criteria)
Caste certificate in Central Government format
Any other relevant document in support of candidature
important_instructions: Inadequately filled or incomplete applications, or applications without the prescribed fee, are summarily rejected and no representation is entertained. False information or suppression of material facts leads to cancellation of candidature, or termination without notice if already appointed. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. The Institute may increase or decrease the number of vacancies, and reserves the right not to fill any or all advertised posts. The Institute may terminate the engagement if performance is unsatisfactory, on misconduct, if the project is discontinued, if funds are not available, if services are no longer required, or if false information is detected. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right; unauthorised absence attracts disciplinary action including termination. Selected candidates must keep complete confidentiality about patients, official records, research data and administrative matters, during and after the engagement. Corrigendum, addendum, interview schedule and final result, if any, will be uploaded only on the official website of the Institute. Any dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts at Bathinda, Punjab only.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bathinda
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bathinda is located at Jodhpur Romana, Mandi Dabwali Road, Bathinda, Punjab - 151001. This recruitment is issued by its Recruitment Cell for the Addiction Treatment Facility, which is coordinated by the National Drug Dependence Treatment Centre (NDDTC), AIIMS, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. The post is unreserved: the notice shows UR-02 and no other category. Age limit: between 21-35 years. The cut-off date for the upper age limit and for all other qualifications and experience is the last date of Google Form submission, 19 December 2026. The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability. No age relaxation is available to reserved category candidates applying for the unreserved vacancy. Other age relaxation is regulated by the instructions of the Department of Personnel and Training issued from time to time. Candidates in service in any Government Institution must submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer at the time of interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Counsellor receives consolidated remuneration of Rs 56,100/- per month, as approved under the ATF Scheme/NHM norms and adopted by AIIMS Bathinda. No annual increment, Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance or other allowance is admissible unless specifically approved by the funding agency. Statutory deductions are made where applicable. The engagement is purely on contract, initially for 1 year or till continuation of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice says it may be extended subject to satisfactory performance, availability of funds and continuation of the scheme, but also that the contractual appointment shall not be extended beyond one year; if not extended, it lapses automatically. The appointment gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption. The appointee may leave by giving one month's notice or paying salary in lieu of the notice period, or of the shortfall. The Counsellor reports to the Nodal Officer/Principal Investigator, Addiction Treatment Facility (ATF), Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS Bathinda, or any other officer authorised by the Competent Authority. Staff work as per Institute working hours and may be required to work beyond office hours, on holidays or weekends depending on project requirements.

Application form (duly filled) Residence proof Age proof Qualification proof (as mentioned in the essential criteria) NOC document (if applicable) Age relaxation document (if applicable) Experience certificate Caste certificate in Central Government format Proof of application fee paid Any other relevant document in support of candidature

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is on the basis of the interview. Document verification at AIIMS Bathinda is followed by the interview of eligible candidates only, on the same day. The interview date is to be notified later. The Institute may shortlist candidates on educational qualification, experience, suitability or any other criteria considered appropriate by the Selection Committee. Meeting the prescribed qualification does not by itself entitle a candidate to selection. The interview may extend to the next day if the number of applicants is large. No TA/DA or accommodation is provided for attending it. Original documents are verified before the interview and again at joining.

faq.question: Q1. How many Counsellor vacancies are there at AIIMS Bathinda?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 2 Counsellor posts, shown as UR-02, under the Addiction Treatment Facility.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bathinda Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The Google Form must be submitted by 19 December 2026, 05:00 PM IST. The form opened on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology. A minimum of 2 years of experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Bathinda Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 21-35 years, counted as on 19 December 2026. The upper limit is relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Counsellor at AIIMS Bathinda?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs 56,100/- per month. No increment, DA, HRA, Transport Allowance or other allowance is admissible unless the funding agency specifically approves it.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹ 1,180/- for UR / OBC / EWS and ₹ 590/- for SC/ST, with NIL for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. It is paid online only and is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the AIIMS Bathinda Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Submit the Google Form, pay the fee online, and bring the filled application form with documents and fee receipt to the interview. No hard copy needs to be sent.

faq.question: Q8. How are Counsellors selected at AIIMS Bathinda?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of the interview. Document verification is held on the same day, before the interview of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Counsellor job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely contractual for 1 year or till the project continues, whichever is earlier, and gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA or accommodation is provided for attending the interview.
